pairing_code.title: Device Pairing Required
pairing_code.description: Your {device_name} device requires pairing. Please put the device in pairing mode and enter the 6-digit code displayed on the device screen.

error.invalid_pairing_code: Pairing code must be exactly 6 digits
error.pairing_failed: Failed to pair with device. Please ensure the device is in pairing mode and try again.
error.device_not_found: Device not found. Please ensure the device is nearby and in pairing mode.
error.dbus_not_available: Bluetooth pairing not available. Please pair manually using: bluetoothctl pair {device_address}
